items.name: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
items.why: The immediate trigger of the First World War; nothing can 'trigger' WWI now (World War One Begins only mentions it).

items.name: Thirty Years' War
items.why: Exists only as the 1618 event 'Thirty Years War Begins', so the Peace of Westphalia can't 'end' it and the Reformation's link points at a single year.

items.name: Hundred Years' War
items.why: Exists only as the 1337 event, so Joan of Arc can't be 'part of' it. (Could be a Step 3a-style shared id with the event.)

items.name: Intolerable Acts
items.why: Britain's response to the Boston Tea Party, the real link between it and the Revolution.

items.name: Voting Rights Act of 1965
items.why: The Selma marches led to it; the civil rights story stops at the 1964 Act now.

items.name: Greek Alphabet Adapted from Phoenician
items.why: Would let the Phoenician alphabet 'influence' the Greek one, and through it the Latin alphabet.
